### Soul Blinders
Author: Gwen Smith
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/soul-blinders-girlfriends-in-god-may-29-2013.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 5:32
Points:
- Looking around at others causes comparison, insecurity, and distraction from God's plan.
- Just as horses wear blinders to avoid distractions, Christians need spiritual focus.
- God's Word serves as our guide so we do not turn to the right or left.
- Keeping our eyes fixed on Jesus helps earthly concerns and comparisons fade away.
